requirements.description: The user requires an energy class of D or better, so all classes from D upward (A1 to D) are accepted.
User prefers a property near healthcare services for a senior care facility. Set at the 75th percentile (75.06, rounded to 75) of the healthcare distribution.

The user explicitly requires a minimum gross floor area of 1,600 sqm. The 30-person capacity is not converted into a surface filter because no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was supplied. Energy class and proximity to healthcare services are outside the reference columns and are left to other agents.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE surface_area >= 1600 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D') AND healthcare >= 75 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters on surface_area (>= 1600 sqm), energy_class (A1 through D, i.e. D or better), and healthcare proximity score (>= 75). Location constraint is a 3.0 km haversine radius around 45.0677551, 7.6824892, and results are ordered by distance from that point. No comune_code predicate is applied, since the place name alone is not a coordinate constraint.
